Parsing configuration records
=============================

Use :func:`parse_records` for line-oriented configuration input. Empty lines and comments are ignored. Each remaining line must contain an equals separator; malformed input raises :class:`ValueError` instead of silently dropping data.

.. code-block:: python

   records = parse_records(["host=localhost", "port=8080"])
   assert records == [("host", "localhost"), ("port", "8080")]

Client timeout example
======================

Use :func:`Client.get` with an explicit timeout so retries cannot hang forever.

.. code-block:: python

   response = client.get('/health', timeout=5)
   response.raise_for_status()
